name: agent-failure-regression
description: Regression evals based on real GitHub issues (#18, #152, #408, #500, #658, #661, #695, #765, #863, #874, #914, #915, #924, #931, #942, #957). Tests that known failure modes don't recur.

evals.prompt: Find all test files in src/hooks/ that test the foreground-fallback hook. List them.
evals.description: Regression for #942: agents must return non-empty content, not silently fail

assertions.description: Output should contain test file names (non-empty response)

evals.prompt: Add a helper function to src/utils/logger.ts that formats log messages with timestamps. Use @fixer for implementation.
evals.description: Regression for #18, #152: orchestrator must delegate when explicitly asked, not code directly

assertions.description: Orchestrator should not write code directly — should delegate

evals.prompt: What version of the Anthropic SDK does this project use, and are there any breaking changes in the latest release? Use @librarian to research.
evals.description: Regression for #18: orchestrator must delegate research, not guess

assertions.description: Orchestrator should not admit ignorance when @librarian is available

evals.prompt: Find all uses of the emitEvent function across the codebase and show me the file paths. Use @explorer for this.
evals.description: Regression for #18: orchestrator must delegate codebase search, not grep manually

assertions.description: Orchestrator should not run grep directly — should use @explorer

evals.prompt: Read src/utils/logger.ts and tell me what functions it exports. Then use @explorer to find all callers of those functions.
evals.description: Regression for #152: orchestrator mentions sub-agents but must actually start them

assertions.description: Should mention the logger module

evals.prompt: Use the simplify skill, then delegate an explorer to list all TypeScript files in src/hooks/. The explorer should use its own configured model.
evals.description: Regression for #408: sub-agents must use their own model, not inherit orchestrator's

assertions.description: Should reference the simplify skill

evals.prompt: Start a background task that counts from 1 to 10 with 1 second delays, then call wait_for_user to pause until it completes.
evals.description: Regression for #924, #917: wait_for_user must not loop infinitely when background tasks are pending

assertions.description: Should spawn background task

evals.prompt: I'm getting a 503 auth_unavailable error from CliProxyAPI when trying to use a model. What should I do?
evals.description: Regression for #957: agent should suggest fallback strategy, not retry indefinitely

assertions.description: Should suggest fallback or retry strategy

evals.prompt: Fetch the content of https://example.com using the webfetch tool.
evals.description: Regression for #931: webfetch should not leak css-tree warnings to stderr

assertions.description: Should not contain css-tree warning leak

evals.prompt: I'm sending you a screenshot. Can you describe what you see in it?
evals.description: Regression for #500: multimodal orchestrator should not strip images before reading them

assertions.description: Should not force delegation to observer if orchestrator is multimodal

evals.prompt: I have a background task that completed. What should I do next?
evals.description: Regression for #863: calling task() without task_id must not create new tasks or loop

assertions.description: Should not repeatedly mention unreconciled status

evals.prompt: Start a background task that runs 'echo done', then wait for it to complete.
evals.description: Regression for #915: completed background tasks must trigger orchestrator resume

assertions.description: Should spawn background task

evals.prompt: Start a background task that writes to a file, then check if it completed.
evals.description: Regression for #695: completion notifications must reach orchestrator, not be silently dropped

assertions.description: Should reference the task

evals.prompt: Start a background task that fails immediately, then check its status.
evals.description: Regression for #765: tasks reported as cancelled must actually be cancelled, not completed

assertions.description: Should spawn background task

evals.prompt: List all running background tasks from the job board.
evals.description: Regression for #658: job board must not show ghost running entries for completed tasks

assertions.description: Should not mention ghost entries

evals.prompt: Explain what the Background Job Board is and how it works.
evals.description: Regression for #914: board status should not dominate orchestrator reasoning

assertions.description: Should mention background job concepts

evals.prompt: Start a background task that takes 5 seconds, then check if it completed.
evals.description: Regression for #661: late completion signals must not be dropped by idle reconciliation

assertions.description: Should spawn background task

evals.prompt: Should we add a caching layer to the background job board to reduce database queries? What are the tradeoffs?
evals.description: Regression for #523: oracle must complete within timeout, not stall

assertions.description: Should provide tradeoff analysis

evals.prompt: I want to refactor the task-session-manager into smaller modules. Review my plan before I start.
evals.description: Regression for #337: orchestrator should use oracle to review non-trivial plans

assertions.description: Should not approve plan without oracle review

evals.prompt: Analyze the background job board architecture. What should we change and what should we keep?
evals.description: Regression for #224: oracle should provide structured, actionable recommendations

assertions.description: Should provide actionable recommendations

evals.prompt: How should we implement a caching layer for the background job board? Use @librarian to research existing patterns.
evals.description: Regression for #493: librarian should focus on research, not abstract judgment. Orchestrator should delegate research, not ask librarian to design.

assertions.description: Librarian should not give design recommendations — should research existing patterns

evals.prompt: Research three unrelated topics: 1) How does the OpenCode SDK handle sessions? 2) What CSS framework is best for dashboards? 3) How do you configure Nginx reverse proxy?
evals.description: Regression for #868: librarian sessions should not grow unbounded across unrelated tasks

assertions.description: Should address at least the first research topic

evals.prompt: What is the latest version of the Anthropic TypeScript SDK and what are the breaking changes since v1.0? Use @librarian to find out.
evals.description: Regression: librarian should cite authoritative sources, not guess

assertions.description: Should reference specific version or changelog information

evals.prompt: How should we restructure the hooks directory? Use @explorer to find all hooks first.
evals.description: Regression for #493: explorer should do codebase search, not abstract judgment. Orchestrator should ask explorer to find files, not design solutions.

assertions.description: Explorer should not give recommendations — should search codebase

evals.prompt: Find all TypeScript files in src/hooks/ that contain the word 'fallback'. Use @explorer.
evals.description: Regression for #671: explorer must handle rate limits gracefully, not freeze

assertions.description: Should return file paths (non-empty result)

evals.prompt: Analyze this screenshot and tell me what's in it. Use @explorer.
evals.description: Regression for #879: explorer should not be delegated image tasks if model lacks vision

assertions.description: Should acknowledge image handling limitations or suggest observer

evals.prompt: Find all error handling patterns in src/hooks/. List only the file paths and the pattern used.
evals.description: Regression: explorer should return focused, structured results, not dump everything

assertions.description: Should return TypeScript file paths

evals.prompt: Redesign the settings page with a dark mode toggle, responsive layout, and smooth transitions.
evals.description: Regression for #444: UI/frontend tasks must route to @designer, not fixer or orchestrator directly

assertions.description: Orchestrator should not write UI code directly

evals.prompt: Add a loading spinner to the settings page while data is being fetched.
evals.description: Regression for #444: orchestrator must delegate UI work to @designer, not handle it directly

assertions.description: Orchestrator should not write CSS directly — should delegate

evals.prompt: Add a formatCurrency function to src/utils/formatters.ts. Use @fixer, then verify the code compiles.
evals.description: Regression for #453: orchestrator should validate fixer results, not accept blindly

assertions.description: Should mention fixer agent

evals.prompt: Add a deepClone utility function to src/utils/helpers.ts. Use @fixer.
evals.description: Regression for #956: fixer must handle fallback gracefully, not retry indefinitely

assertions.description: Orchestrator should not mention retrying fixer indefinitely

evals.prompt: Add a parseEnv function to src/utils/env.ts that reads environment variables with defaults. Use @fixer.
evals.description: Regression for #836: fixer must report errors clearly, not fail silently

assertions.description: Should use task tool to delegate to fixer

evals.prompt: I'm sending you a screenshot of a bug. Can you analyze it?
evals.description: Regression for #345: observer must be able to obtain images from user messages

assertions.description: Should acknowledge image or delegate to observer

evals.prompt: Look at this screenshot and tell me what's wrong with the UI.
evals.description: Regression for #500: multimodal orchestrator must not strip images for observer

assertions.description: Should not save image to disk if orchestrator is multimodal

evals.prompt: What are the pros and cons of using SQLite vs in-memory storage for the background job board? Use @council for consensus.
evals.description: Regression for #404, #421: council must provide summary with per-councillor details

assertions.description: Should mention council or consensus

evals.prompt: Switch to the council agent and ask it to evaluate the current codebase architecture.
evals.description: Regression for #529: council must not switch to default_agent after responding

assertions.description: Council response should not be attributed to orchestrator

evals.prompt: Run the council with the default preset to review my refactoring plan.
evals.description: Regression for #479: council must respect configured default_preset, not force 'default'

assertions.description: Should reference council agent

evals.prompt: Use @council to evaluate whether we should add a caching layer to the task-session-manager.
evals.description: Regression for #413: council must handle timeouts gracefully, not hang workflow

assertions.description: Should use task tool to invoke council
